annotations.title: Is this price a good deal

description: Whether a price offered for one product is a good deal: GOOD DEAL, NOT A GOOD DEAL or NOT ENOUGH DATA, on the same basis as should_i_buy. Compares the price with the lowest current retailer price iDevice read today, the lowest recent price of this exact model from published prices and iDevice's own checks (said as low_period with its basis, once there is enough price history to name one) and how close the offer is to that lowest price, and gives the buy-or-wait verdict at that price where it can state one. Each line says what it rests on. No probability is given. A line slug (for example 'samsung-galaxy-ring') names the line's newest model; when that model is not on sale the answer is for the newest model of the line that is, and resolved_to says which and why.

price_usd.description: The price offered, in US dollars

retailer.description: Where the price was offered, e.g. 'Best Buy'. Repeated in the answer as given.
